summary: Samantha Voix v2: a new speakProgress control lets the app have the voice read, verbatim and on the same turn, up to 6 user-oriented progress lines while a brain execution runs; refusals are per turn, provider tools are refused during a progress line, and warmReady announces progressReadback.

routes.change: new v2 control: verbatim progress line on the owning brain turn while its execution runs
routes.budget: no Gateway call, no storage; at most 6 lines of 200 characters per turn

evidence: scripts/test-voice-turn-protocol.cjs (37, 7 new) and scripts/test-warm-v2-ownership.cjs, already registered in .github/workflows/ci.yml (job mobile-ui-plugin)

capability_impact.detail: No capability added or changed. A progress line executes nothing; payment and deterministic routes are unchanged.

architecture_impact.reason: Revision v2 of the voice ADR: the voice protocol gains a bounded progress readback inside the existing turn owner. No new store, router, scheduler or retry.

mcp_parity.detail: No MCP tool or adapter change.

rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the Companion with companion-deploy.sh; the app stops sending progress when warmReady no longer announces progressReadback.
